query ListWorkspaceRunHistory($limitPerAgent: Int = 6) {
  listWorkspaceRunHistory(limitPerAgent: $limitPerAgent) {
    workspaceRootPath
    workspaceName
    agentDefinitions {
      agentDefinitionId
      agentName
      runs {
        runId
        summary
        createdAt
        archivedAt
        terminatedAt
        status
        isActive
        shouldConnectStream
        statusSource
        hasCollaboration
        __typename
      }
      __typename
    }
    teamDefinitions {
      teamDefinitionId
      teamDefinitionName
      runs {
        teamRunId
        teamDefinitionId
        teamDefinitionName
        coordinatorAddress
        workspaceRootPath
        summary
        createdAt

          runtimeKind

        __typename
      }
      __typename
    }
    __typename
  }
}
